method: Published Table S2 75-gene coefficients; CPM >=1 filter; log2(1+CPM); between-sample quantile normalization with ties; per-gene cohort z-standardization; weighted sum; no fitting / direction flip.
not_identical_to_published_protocol_warn: One published weighted gene (FOXI2) is under the cohort-wide mean CPM filter and explicitly retained; full published analysis may use different normalization, annotation and a high/low threshold. This is an approximate quantitative implementation, NOT proof of exact original HfRI reproduction.

logCPM_without_quantile_sensitivity.orientation: higher HfRI means higher recurrence risk, weights fixed a priori

quantile_normalized.orientation: higher HfRI means higher recurrence risk, weights fixed a priori
